## Angular Ripple Directive

The [Kendo UI for Angular Ripple](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/ripple) is a directive that provides the [Material ink ripple effect](https://m3.material.io/guidelines/motion/choreography.html#choreography-radial-reaction) for the Kendo UI for Angular components and is fully compatible with all available Kendo UI themes.
